subject: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@helixfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps

Tom — great to speak this morning. Quick recap + the actions we discussed so we have a single source of truth: 

- Attendees: Tom Weaver (Helix) / Jasmine Liu (Redwood AE) / Aditya Rao (Solutions)
- Primary asks from Helix: 1) vendor intake & SOC2 evidence, 2) expected PO & invoice cadence, 3) a one-week pilot to validate perf and cost metrics

Action items we captured from the call: 
1) I will send our Redwood vendor packet and a draft SOW/pricing breakdown for review (attached).
2) Tom to introduce the procurement contact and share the Helix PO template and any preferred invoice remit details.
3) Helix to confirm target vendor onboarding window — you mentioned ~4–6 weeks depending on security review; please confirm.
4) We’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement sync (redwood + Helix procurement) to walk through the vendor intake and the SOC2 artifacts.

Questions for you to confirm in reply: 
- Who should receive invoices (email + remit address)?
- Any specific security attestation or questionnaire beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test report)?
- Is a short pilot (1 week, capped at $X) acceptable to start before final PO?

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.zip (750KB) — includes SOC2 summary, certs, W-9, standard MSA; SOW_Redwood_Helix_v0.2.docx (pricing redline stub).

Proposed times for the procurement sync (PT): Wed 1/20 10:00–10:30, Wed 1/20 14:00–14:30, Thu 1/21 09:00–09:30 — open to other slots.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com | (415) 555-0134

From: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@helixfin.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helixfin.com>, procurement@helixfin.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps

Thanks, Jasmine — good recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@helixfin.com (cc’d). Primary owner is Priyanka Shah (procurement lead).
- PO timing: our procurement intake takes ~3–6 weeks once vendor intake is submitted. The SOC2 paperwork will be the gating item. If Redwood can provide completed vendor intake + SOC2 report + standard MSA redlines, we can start the review this week.
- Invoice remit: Accounts Payable prefers invoices to be sent to ap@helixfin.com with payment terms Net 45; please confirm if Redwood invoices to ap@helixfin.com or a different remit.
- Pilot: Procurement is ok with a capped pilot, but legal wants the SOW language tightened (scope, termination clause, and liability cap). If you can provide an updated SOW with scope limited to the pilot, legal can fast-track.

Attached: Helix_PO_Template.xlsx (small sample). 

I can join the procurement sync Wed 1/20 at 10:00 PT — Priyanka will confirm availability.

—
Tom Weaver
Director, Data Platforms — Helix Financial
Tom.Weaver@helixfin.com | (312) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@helixfin.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>, procurement@helixfin.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps

Thanks for the details, Tom — appreciate the clarity. A few internal commitments from our side to keep momentum: 

1) I’ll produce a pilot-scoped SOW by end of day Tue 1/19 that narrows scope and includes a 30-day opt-out and a liability cap aligned to our standard policy.
2) We will attach our full SOC2 Type II report and an internal security FAQ to the vendor packet; if procurement prefers a separate pen-test report, I’ll check our records and share the latest summary.
3) Finance note: Redwood can accept Net 45 for enterprise customers; confirm billing entity and remit address so we populate the PO properly.
4) To speed review, Grace will join the procurement sync to go through the vendor intake fields live (so procurement has everything they need in one meeting).

Proposed remediation for tight timelines: if Helix confirms an MSA redline set (preferred clauses) in advance, we can send a marked-up MSA within 48 hours after the procurement sync and request an expedited review.

Attaching: SOW_Redwood_Helix_v0.2.docx (will be updated with pilot language), Redwood_Vendor_Packet.zip (updated).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@helixfin.com>, procurement@helixfin.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:02:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps

Adding my voice — I’ll be on the Wed 1/20 10:00 PT sync and will bring the vendor intake checklist so we can complete fields in real time (legal / billing / security contacts).

Quick note on billing fields we’ll need during the meeting: legal entity name, tax ID (EIN), remit email/address, and preferred PO number format. If Tom or Priyanka can surface those ahead of the call it will shave time off the intake.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com

From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@helixfin.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@helixfin.com>, procurement@helixfin.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow readout + scheduling: procurement contacts, PO timing, and next steps

Thanks all — confirmed: I’ll represent procurement on the sync tomorrow (10:00 PT). A few items I uploaded for your review before the meeting: Helix_PO_Template.xlsx (attached), vendor-intake-checklist.docx (internal), and our preferred MSA clause set — link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4d5E-example.

Billing / remit details: 
- Legal name: Helix Financial Services LLC
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Invoice remit: ap@helixfin.com (please send invoices to that address)
- Payment terms: Net 45 (unless otherwise negotiated)

We will prioritize vendors that provide complete security artifacts and a narrow pilot SOW. If the SOW and vendor intake are complete by end-of-day tomorrow we will aim to issue a PO within 10 business days.

See you at 10:00 PT — Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
Head of Procurement | Helix Financial
procurement@helixfin.com | (312) 555-0144
